text:
liam: heads up — scorecard diff in console is lumping quantized runs with fp baselines. noticed on the run linked below, all quant experiments show up as "no change" in the comparison table despite clear token-level delta in samples. https://ci.redwood.internal/job/runner/3492 :eyes:

anita: hmm that sounds like the export tags might be collapsing. which runner version? did the metric exporter change the tag name?

liam: runner v0.9.2. attaching the snippet from the exported JSON (trimmed):

```
{
  "run_id": "r-2026-03-01-3492",
  "model": "rw-instruct-3b-q8",
  "metrics": [
    {"name": "bleu", "value": 0.72, "tags": {"precision": "q8"}},
    {"name": "perplexity", "value": 23.4}
  ]
}
```

liam: note: `tags` is present for some metrics but the scorecard grouping expects `variant_tag` with values like `quantized` or `fp`. so dashboard treats quant runs as untagged and merges them.

anita: actually I can reproduce locally. runner used to write `variant: "quantized"` at top-level run metadata; v0.9.2 switched to per-metric `tags.precision`. aggregator code assumes `run.metadata.variant` first, then falls back to `metric.tags.variant` — it doesn't check `metric.tags.precision`.

jordan: quick options: (1) patch aggregator to accept precision/tag aliases, (2) patch exporter to write the legacy `variant` field, (3) migration transform in ingestion pipeline. we should pick the least risky for next deploy.

sara: preference is aggregator patch + small compatibility mapping in ingestion. migrate older records on the analytics side so existing dashboards stay stable. also need a unit test for the diff grouping.

anita: OK. I'll open a tiny PR on the aggregator: map `precision` -> `variant` and `precision: q8|q4` -> `quantized`. will add tests. PR in ~30m.

ci-bot: Build started: runner-compat-patch #1187 — https://ci.redwood.internal/job/runner-compat-patch/1187 :gear:

eval-eng: note: the diff panel groups by `variant` + `seed`. if `variant` is empty we get an empty bucket that collapses things. add a quick check in the UI to show untagged as `(untagged)` so we can visually debug until the backend fix lands.

liam: yep UI tweak makes sense as a temporary patch. also flagging the failing scorecard: Scorecard ID sc-2026-03-01-77. After the patch can we re-run the export and reindex?

anita: will re-run export after PR merges. command I'll run locally: `./tools/export_runs --run r-2026-03-01-3492 --format ndjson | gzip > /tmp/r3492.ndjson.gz` then push to staging ingest: `gsutil cp /tmp/r3492.ndjson.gz gs://redwood-staging/exports/` and trigger pipeline.

liam: thanks. can we also surface a lightweight telemetry alert if >5% of metrics in a run have `tags` but no `variant`? might catch these early.

jordan: good idea. I'll add a check in the exporter health endpoint. PR set to review after lunch. :+1:

sara: ping @anita once deployed so product can validate scorecards.

anita: will do. pushing work now. :rocket:
